goal: Group documents that describe one person, using non-HLA identity evidence, and propose everything else for human review.
non_goals: identity verification against any official record
preconditions: config/locus_genotype_frequencies.json measured from the current extraction
invariants: HLA similarity alone never merges people
a conflicting blood group or role blocks a link rather than weakening it
a merge decision is recorded, reversible, and attributed
a cluster with an open conflict is UNKNOWN to matching
the printed name is stored only as a salted hash
acceptance: two documents matching on five loci are proposed for review and never auto-linked
the same sender posting the same genotype twice auto-links
a blood-group conflict blocks a link that every other signal supports
the frequency table is regenerated whenever extraction changes, and linking refuses to run without it
